description: This file defines the 'Header' class within the OpenCart platform, responsible for generating the header section data for web pages. It gathers data like site title, styles, scripts, logo, wishlist info, and user account links, and renders the header view.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing data for the header view in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the page header, including site info, navigation links, account info, and other common header components.
